hooks.command: echo '📝 Code changed - consider running testing-agent next'

hooks.prompt: TESTS check: if code was written this session (Edit/Write on .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.prisma) but tests were not run afterward, that is a failure. If tests were run, or no code files were touched, it passes. If it passes, respond: {"ok": true}. If it fails, respond: {"ok": false, "reason": "<what to run>"}. Respond ONLY with valid JSON.
